title_sq: Apartament 2+1 në shitje Kompleksi Mangalem+post parkmi
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 tek Kompleksi Mangalem .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar .
Apartamenti organizohet nga 1 soxhorno e madhe bashke me kendin e gatimit ,
2 dhoma gjumi , 1 tualet me dritare dhe 1 ballkon .
Apartamenti ka ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites dhe ka orientim Jug - Lindje - Perendim .
Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne detaje dhe i arreduar ne menyre bashkohore ,
ku te gjitha orendite jane te markave me prestigjoze ne treg .
Ne cmim eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi.
Parket AC 5
Vetrata plastike dopio xham .
Tavane te varura .
Ndicim LED .
Garderobe .
Izolim Akustik .
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, Mangalem complex+parking post
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Mangalem Complex. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized by 1 large living room with kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with window and 1 balcony. The apartment has natural lighting throughout the day and has a South-East-West orientation. The apartment is invested in details and furnished in a contemporary way, where all the furniture is from the most prestigious brands in the market. A parking post is included in the price. Parquet AC 5 Double glazed plastic windows. Suspended ceilings. LED lighting. Wardrobe. Acoustic insulation.
